pages.title: Patrol Supplies
pages.text: This entry follows merchant_shops.json#star_palace_patrol_supply and uses the existing market and item-currency flow. It adds no patrol reputation screen, patrol-order UI, merchant loader, or extra network packet.

pages.title: Current Stock
pages.text: Available listings are body_guard_talisman and anti_demon_talisman. The first reuses a protection talisman for 25 low-grade metal spirit stones, stock 10; the second reuses a fire talisman for 55, stock 5. Both currently restock every 48000 ticks.

pages.title: Planned Content
pages.text: bu_tian_pill, the Star Palace reputation-100 gate, patrol-board quests, monthly or personal quotas, exact anti-demon rules, and patrol rewards are not yet implemented. This page describes only existing shop-data hooks.
